name: Land Trust Bird Conservation Initiative Small Grant Program
summary: Annual small grants for U.S. land trusts and conservation partners to build bird-conservation capacity or manage and restore habitat on private lands.

calls.label: 2027 small grant RFP
calls.recurring: RFP opens in January; proposals are due by 11:59 p.m. on March 1.

recurring.quote: This is an annual grant cycle with the RFP for the small grant program opening in January and proposals due by 11:59 p.m. on March 1.

applicant_types.quote: Any land trust (does not need to be accredited) or conservation organization partnering with a land trust may apply.

geography.quote: Applicant organizations must reside within the U.S.

access.quote: Watch for our next RFP in January 2027!

window.quote: This is an annual grant cycle with the RFP for the small grant program opening in January and proposals due by 11:59 p.m. on March 1.

amount.quote: Capacity and Partnership Projects: 6 grants of $10,000 each Management and Restoration Projects: 8 grants of $25,000 each

co_finance_required.quote: Co-funding is not required, but strong applications will be supplemented by in-kind or partner contributions, matching dollars, or other resources
